product.format: 1024 lines, each five lowercase hex digits and LF
product.index_order: line i+1 holds coefficient for sample index i, i=0..1023

conversion.operation: unpack <1024I; encode each exact integer as 05x plus LF; verify reverse packing

runtime.path_policy: Different path must select these exact manifest-bound bytes; verify SHA256 before compile/run.
runtime.missing_or_short: ROM defaults to out-of-range sentinel; consumed invalid coefficients abort with error COEFFICIENT.
runtime.in_range_substitution: Not detected by hardware range check; byte identity is an integration preflight requirement.
